name: TARENTULA HISPANICA
key_symptoms: Intense pain, as if thousands of needles were pricking into brain. Vertigo. Wants hair brushed or head rubbed.
Palpitation; præcordial anguish, sensation as if heart twisted and turned around.

Weakness of legs; choreic movements. Numbness of legs. Multiple sclerosis, with trembling. Twitching and jerking. Yawning with uneasiness of legs, must move them constantly. Extraordinary contractions and movements.
guiding_symptoms: Intense pain, as if thousands of needles were pricking into brain. Vertigo. Wants hair brushed or head rubbed.

better: in open air, music, bright colors, rubbing affected parts

mind_symptoms: Sudden alteration of mood. Foxy. Destructive impulses; moral relaxation. Must constantly busy herself or walk. Sensitive to music. Averse to company, but wants some one present. Ungrateful, discontented. Guided by whims.
head_symptoms: Intense pain, as if thousands of needles were pricking into brain. Vertigo. Wants hair brushed or head rubbed.
urinary_symptoms: Sexual excitement; lasciviousness reaching almost to insanity; seminal emissions.
musculoskeletal_symptoms: Weakness of legs; choreic movements. Numbness of legs. Multiple sclerosis, with trembling. Twitching and jerking. Yawning with uneasiness of legs, must move them constantly. Extraordinary contractions and movements.
